review_candidates.job_function: Project Management, Analyst, and Information Technology
review_candidates.description: GIC is one of the world’s largest sovereign wealth funds. With over 2,000 employees across 11 locations around the world, we invest in more than 40 countries globally across asset classes and businesses. Working at GIC gives you exposure to an extraordinary network of the world’s industry leaders. As a leading global long-term investor, we Work at the Point of Impact for Singapore’s financial future, and the communities we invest in worldwide. Technology Group We experiment, design, and lead a 24×7 global business where we support core capabilities in asset management, trading, investment operations, and risk management. We deliver secure, reliable, and integrated solutions, and provide insights on new, and emerging technologies. Infrastructure & Cybersecurity Resilience (ICR) We design, build, and secure the technology foundations that power GIC’s global investment operations. We aim to deliver resilient, scalable, and secure infrastructure that empowers our people and businesses to perform securely, efficiently, and effectively. What impact can you make in this role? The AVP/VP, Network Engineer is responsible for the design, engineering, and delivery of network infrastructure across all GIC data centres and office sites globally. This hands-on technical role owns the architecture and build of Data Centre, Campus, and WAN/SD-WAN networks across a multi-vendor estate, and applies network automation to improve consistency, scalability, and delivery velocity. The role partners closely with Network Operations, Security, and other infrastructure engineering teams to translate business and technical requirements into resilient, secure, and standardised network solutions. This is an individual-contributor technical role. In addition to deep hands-on engineering across Data Centre Networks, Campus Networks (wired and wireless), and SD-WAN, the role engages vendors and product principals to drive feature enhancements and influence product roadmaps, and requires the ability to develop, read and make edits to automation code (Ansible), backed by sound knowledge of financial-sector security and compliance requirements. What will you do as an AVP/VP, Network Automation and Reliability Engineer? Network Engineering & Solution Design Leadership Lead the design and engineering of network solutions across Data Centre, Campus, and WAN/SD-WAN domains, ensuring scalability, resilience, security, and performance. Produce high-quality low-level and high-level designs (HLDs/LLDs), standards, and reference architectures aligned to financial-industry best practices. Act as the technical authority and design-approval reviewer for network changes and new builds, ensuring engineering rigour and adherence to architectural standards. Partner with Network Operations, Security, and other infrastructure engineering teams to translate requirements into deployable, well-documented solutions. Core Engineering Responsibilities Data Centre Networks Design, build, and evolve data centre fabrics using EVPN/VXLAN, Cisco ACI, and modern spine-leaf architectures across a multi-vendor estate (e.g., Cisco, Arista, Juniper). Engineer multi-tenancy, segmentation, and high-availability designs, including integration with load balancers (e.g., F5 LTM/GTM) and L4–L7 services. Define oversubscription, capacity, and failure-domain strategies to support trading and critical workloads. Campus Networks Engineer enterprise campus LAN and wireless solutions (routing, switching, Wi-Fi 6/7 with a managed controller ecosystem) using standardised, templated designs across sites of varying size. Implement access security and segmentation (802.1X, NAC, zoning) in collaboration with Security teams. Ensure resilient, performant designs for corporate connectivity. SD-WAN, WAN & Secure Connectivity Design and deliver SD-WAN and WAN solutions, including overlay transport, application-aware routing, secure connectivity, and cloud on-ramp, using leading platforms (e.g., Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN/Viptela, Fortinet, Versa, VMware VeloCloud, or equivalent). Embed Zero Trust and SASE principles into WAN and remote-access designs (e.g., Zscaler ZIA/ZPA, Prisma Access, or equivalent). Lead WAN modernisation and migration efforts (e.g., MPLS to SD-WAN) with structured, low-risk transition plans. Engineer secure interconnectivity between data centres, campus sites, and cloud providers. Network Automation (Ansible) Develop new, read, interpret, and make edits to existing Ansible playbooks, roles, and Jinja2 templates to support network provisioning, configuration management, and compliance. Maintain and extend standardised configuration templates, and use automated validation within delivery workflows. Apply automation to drive configuration consistency, support drift detection, and reduce manual TOIL across the network estate. (Preferred) Familiarity with adjacent automation/IaC tooling — Python scripting, Terraform, YAML, and CI/CD pipelines (Git-based) — to support scalable, repeatable delivery. Security & Resilience Integration Embed security baselines, hardening standards, and segmentation into all network designs. Engineer for high availability, redundancy, and compliance with internal RTO/RPO and resilience targets. Project Delivery & Lifecycle Management Lead engineering delivery for network projects from design through build, testing, and handover to operations. Develop detailed test plans, simulation/validation approaches, implementation steps, and rollback strategies for high-risk changes. Maintain comprehensive design documentation, build guides, and as-built records to meet operational and audit expectations. Observability, Performance & Troubleshooting Design and apply network observability — telemetry, monitoring, flow analytics, and dashboards — to provide visibility across DC, campus, and WAN. Provide advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis (RCA) for complex, cross-domain network issues, including performance optimisation. Establish baselines and proactive alerting to detect and pre-empt performance degradation. Vendor & Product Engagement Engage vendors and product principals to evaluate technologies and influence feature enhancements and product roadmaps aligned to the firm’s network strategy. Provide structured technical feedback, raise and track enhancement and defect requests, and validate fixes and new features through proofs-of-concept and testing. Maintain strong working relationships with OEMs and partners to support technical escalations, product lifecycle planning, and assessment of emerging technologies. Collaboration & Standards Work closely with the Network Operations team to ensure solutions are operable, monitored, and supportable, and to incorporate operational feedback into designs. Define and maintain engineering standards, design templates, and gold-standard configuration baselines. Act as a senior technical escalation point for complex network issues and share engineering knowledge across teams. Governance, Risk & Compliance Ensure all network designs and changes adhere to internal controls, security baselines, and regulatory frameworks (MAS-TRM, CSA CCoP, and NIST CISF guidelines). Support internal/external audits with design documentation, technical evidence, and explanations of network controls and configurations. What qualifications or skills should you possess in this role? Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience. Experience: 8–12 years of experience in Network Engineering, with at least 3–5 years in a senior design/engineering capacity—preferably in the financial industry. (AVP candidates: 6–10 years with demonstrated hands-on engineering depth.) Technical Expertise: Data Centre Networks (EVPN/VXLAN, Cisco ACI, spine-leaf, F5 LTM/GTM) across a multi-vendor estate (Cisco, Arista, Juniper) Enterprise Campus Networks (routing, switching, Wi-Fi 6/7 and wireless controller ecosystems) SD-WAN design and delivery on leading platforms (e.g., Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN/Viptela, Fortinet, Versa, VMware VeloCloud) and WAN technologies Zero Trust / SASE and network security (segmentation, NAC, IDS/IPS, firewalls; e.g., Zscaler or Prisma Access or Netskope) Working ability to create, read and edit network automation code, primarily Ansible (playbooks, roles, Jinja2 templates), with version control (Git) (Preferred) Adjacent automation/IaC — Python, Terraform, YAML, CI/CD pipelines Strong knowledge of networking protocols (BGP, OSPF, MPLS, IPsec, DNS, DHCP, QoS) Network observability and monitoring tooling (telemetry, flow analytics, dashboards) Cloud Networking (AWS, GCP, Azure) Certifications (preferred): Professional certifications such as CCNP/CCIE (Enterprise or Data Center); relevant security or SD-WAN vendor certifications Familiarity with ITIL, NIST CSF, and financial-sector risk frameworks Comfortable reading and modifying automation scripts (Ansible, Python) to improve consistency and reduce operational risk Soft Skills Strong technical depth with the ability to lead complex network design and delivery end-to-end as an individual contributor. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and root-cause-analysis skills, with clear communication for both technical and executive audiences. Ability to engage and influence vendors and product principals to shape enhancements and roadmaps. Collaborative mindset with the ability to influence across architecture, operations, and compliance teams. Work at the Point of Impact We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact. At the same time, we believe that flexibility allows us to do our best work and be our best selves. Thus, our teams come into the office four days per week to harness the benefits of in-person collaboration, but have the flexibility to choose which days they work from home and adjust this arrangement as situational needs arise. Manage backups, business continuity routines and disaster recovery procedures within scope, aligning with global standards as the cloud transition progresses. Coordinate and assist the provisioning and installation of new equipment during upgrade cycles, new store openings and other business expansions, in close coordination with the regional and global teams. Coordinate external vendors as needed. Collaborate and coordinate closely with the IT Project & Support Specialist and the PC & Telecommunications Specialist on shared activities such as store openings, hardware rollouts and end-user support. Collaborate with corporate, retail and project stakeholders to anticipate support needs, improve user experience and identify opportunities to streamline retail technology. Maintain and update documentation, asset records and other shared materials to ensure accuracy and usability across the team. Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, Wi-Fi, firewalls) and enterprise end-user computing. Working knowledge of cloud and SaaS-based services and their integration with retail operations. Windows Server administration skills to support residual on-premise systems at the stores and corporate. Cybersecurity fundamentals applied to retail and end-user environments. Know-how to formalize and draw up documentation relating to projects, processes and infrastructure changes. Completeness and accuracy of new installations and POS configurations by go-live deadlines. Quality of coordination across the regional IT team, measured by smooth execution of joint initiatives. Overall user satisfaction with retail technology and end-user support. Demonstrated ability to balance hands-on technical work with cross-functional coordination across peers and external vendors. The Verizon Network Security team is looking for a highly motivated and experienced Principal Engineer to join the Net-Sec Defense Organization under the Broadband Access team. You will be responsible for owning the Network security posture, Security Lifecycle and protection against threats across the Broadband access network that includes, but is not limited to Edge Routers, Broadband Access routers and switches, CPE equipment and RAN transport infrastructure. The candidate will be required to understand complex network architectures utilizing various protocols, topologies, and vendor hardware . This role involves hands-on work and demonstrating subject matter expertise with Routers, switches, and other networking gear, as well as Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) tools, particularly Splunk and ISE. The engineer would be required to leverage automation platforms to develop scripts and tools to enhance security operations and play a key role in monitoring, analyzing, and leading response to network security incidents while implementing proactive measures to safeguard critical assets. You will be responsible for continuously monitoring and proactively detecting threats to safeguard network functions and assets, with a focus on leveraging automation and AI. This includes accountability for the network security scorecard for each network element type. Additionally, you will collaborate with internal organizations and vendors to improve security posture by implementing Network Security Policies across diverse network elements. Planning, designing, and leading execution of Network Security policies across all owned assets. Utilize existing expertise of routing, switching and network architecture to build a deep understanding of the network assets under your span of control and the product and feature roadmap. Quickly assess the impact of vulnerabilities and identify End-of-Life/End-of-Support hardware/software to create and lead a remediation plan. Discovering, identifying, and inventorying all network assets and asset information (model, version, etc) in your respective area of responsibility. Drive continuous improvement of network visibility and telemetry collection to strengthen detection and response capabilities. Lead the development of baseline operations for the team and implement threat detections, automated alerts to proactively identify potential cyber threats, leveraging SIEM tools such as Splunk. Lead the development of incident response protocols to quickly identify, contain, and resolve network security incidents and threats. Execute root cause analysis for incidents, perform regular security control assessments, and lead strategic security solution implementation in a highly scalable environment. Ensuring that the security controls planned for the Networks are operating effectively by performing audits. Leverage network automation and scripting to make the process efficient. Lead the development and upkeep of network automation systems for ongoing security monitoring and early identification of security incidents. Offer technical guidance and expert feedback on the Vendor Plan of Record (POR), selection of security/monitoring tools, and vendor engagements. Develop essential technical documentation, including playbooks, Confluence pages, Network diagrams, and Method of Procedures (MOPs). Prepare and deliver quarterly presentations to leadership detailing project status and updates. Mentor Team members as well as Organizational partners and act as the overall SME. Building healthy relationships across the Operations, Engineering, and Planning organizations to better understand the current and future landscape of the network. What We’re Looking For... You’ll need to have: Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training. Demonstrated leadership skills as a project and/or team lead for cross-functional project teams and vendor management. Expert understanding of Spine, Leaf, SDN, OTNGN, and Hub & Spoke network architectures. Expert-level understanding of routing and switching security, including BGP and IGP security, is mandatory, e.g., BGP hijacking, Route injection, and managing complex ACLs. Hands-on experience with internet-scale data sets such as Netflow, BGP, DNS, and IDS logs. Fluency in security frameworks, particularly the application of CIS Benchmarks (Level 1 & 2 hardening) and mitigating MITRE ATT&CK Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs) on network devices, along with a solid understanding of network security fundamentals. Expertise in using Python, API, Ansible, or Terraform-type tools to automate and develop custom security “health checks” on network devices. Ability to assess and understand complex transport and 5G-SA network architectures. Understanding of network security fundamental policies and principles. Experience with utilizing SIEM tools like Splunk for performing analysis. Even better if you have one or more of the following: Network Security certifications such as CISSP or other ISC2 certifications. Routing and Switching certifications like CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent vendor certs. Experience with Splunk performing data analysis, Dashboard creation, alerting, and automation. Familiarity with Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions and SIEM tools. Demonstrated organization and project management skills. Knowledge of technical products and systems development lifecycle within a large global enterprise environment. Effective written, interpersonal, and verbal communication skills. Ability to work with diverse stakeholder,s including highly technical teams, business owners, and executives. Strong leadership and mentoring abilities, with experience guiding and developing teams. If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. ***This role can be located out of any US based Verizon hub location.*** Where you’ll be working In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies. Scheduled Weekly Hours 40 Equal Employment Opportunity Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. Benefits And Compensation Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $120,500.00 - $231,000.00.
